Messages.Author: APDI#1
Messages.Body:
Can/does Bang-Nakh (or Bastard Sword) augment an Undead Strength *hand*
strike?

Sorrow

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
APDI#1 <ap...@cais.com> writes:
>Can/does Bang-Nakh (or Bastard Sword) augment an Undead Strength *hand*
>strike?

Actually, the reverse is true. An Undead Strength strike can be used
to augment hand or *melee weapon* strike.

So, you can use superior Undead Strength to hit with your Bang Nakh for
(hand + 4) damage.

Messages.Author: Sorrow
Messages.Body:
>>Can/does Bang-Nakh (or Bastard Sword) augment an Undead Strength *hand*
>>strike?
>Actually, the reverse is true. An Undead Strength strike can be used
>to augment hand or *melee weapon* strike.

Yes, I know. Perhaps I should have added the reason I was asking: If a minion
has Bang-Nakh and they play Undead Strength as a hand strike so they can then
throw on Wolf's Claws, would the Tiger's Claws augment that damage? The card
text says '+2 hand damage', but was erratted to be a meelee weapon.
But to me there is a grey area where I don't strike with the Bang-Nakh, but
with something else and I would like to know if in that case does it give the
+2?

Sorrow

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
cbo...@apdi.net (Sorrow) writes:
>Yes, I know. Perhaps I should have added the reason I was asking:
>If a minion has Bang-Nakh and they play Undead Strength as a hand
>strike so they can then throw on Wolf's Claws, would the Tiger's
>Claws augment that damage? The card text says '+2 hand damage', but
>was erratted to be a meelee weapon. But to me there is a grey area
>where I don't strike with the Bang-Nakh, but with something else and
>I would like to know if in that case does it give the +2?

Ah. Sorry for the base ruling presented earlier, then.

As printed, yes (B-N acts like a Signpost).

But, with the official errata making B-N a "Strike: Hand +2"-dealing
melee weapon, you cannot treat the B-N as a hand strike, nor may the
B-N be used to modify a hand strike. So, no Wolf Claws on the Tiger
Claws.
